gre_subject.quote: The GRE Physics Test is NOT REQUIRED for all applicants.

funding.value: All physics PhD students get a tuition waiver plus a TA, RA or fellowship stipend (USD 35,504 a year); top international applicants may get an extra Amelio Fellowship of USD 5,500 a year.
funding.quote: All Ph.D. students in the School of Physics receive a tuition waiver and financial support through teaching assistantships (TAs), research assistantships (RAs), or fellowships. | The current stipend for Ph.D. students is $35,504 per year.

also.quote: The School of Physics provides these top-up awards to our top international applicants thanks to a generous donation from alumnus Gil Amelio.

entry_route.value: Research-track applicants should apply straight to the PhD; a physics BS is not strictly needed if upper-level physics was taken
entry_route.quote: If your career plan is to do Research, you should apply directly to the Ph.D. program – not the MS Program.

app_fee.quote: As of August 1, 2023, the fee for international applicants is $105 per application.

fee_waiver.value: Institute waivers for outstanding undergraduate achievement or recruitment events; internationals must submit ALL materials (incl. English scores) before requesting
fee_waiver.quote: Georgia Tech provides application fee waivers to recognize outstanding undergraduate achievement and engage prospective students in recruitment events where Georgia Tech is affiliated. | International applicants must submit all required application materials prior to requesting a fee waiver.

gre_general.quote: The General GRE Test is NOT REQUIRED for all applicants.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 106 (scores direct from ETS); IELTS 7.5 with every band 7+ (among the highest in this list)
toefl_min.quote: The TOEFL minimum is 106 and official scores must be sent directly from ETS. | The IELTS test minimum is 7.5, and all skills must be greater than or equal to 7.

english_waiver.value: All applicants must demonstrate English proficiency at application, regardless of citizenship
english_waiver.quote: All applicants must demonstrate English proficiency at the time of application, regardless of citizenship status.

ielts_min.value: Physics requires IELTS 7.5 overall with every band at 7 or above (higher than the Institute minimum of 7).
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS test minimum is 7.5, and all skills must be greater than or equal to 7.

notes: Very high English-test thresholds: plan test dates early.
